For purposes of this subsection, “English learner” means 26 the same as defined in section 280.4. 27 Sec. 3. APPLICABILITY. The following applies to open 28 enrollment applications, requests, and notifications filed by a 29 parent or guardian pursuant to section 282.18 on or after the 30 effective date of this Act: 31 The section of this Act enacting section 282.18, subsection 32 8A. 33 EXPLANATION 34 The inclusion of this explanation does not constitute agreement with 35 -2- LSB 5484YC (1) 91 jda/jh 2/ 3 H.F. _____ the explanation’s substance by the members of the general assembly. 1 This bill modifies provisions related to English learner 2 participation in open enrollment. 3 The bill provides that if a parent or guardian files a 4 request for an English learner to open enroll, the request 5 shall be granted only if the receiving district maintains a 6 program to provide special instruction to English learners that 7 is appropriate to meet the English learner’s educational needs 8 and the enrollment of the English learner in the receiving 9 district’s special instruction program would not cause the size 10 of the class or caseload in that special instruction program 11 in the receiving district to exceed the maximum class size or 12 caseload, and if the English learner would be assigned to a 13 general education class, there is sufficient classroom space in 14 the general education class to which the English learner would 15 be assigned. The bill establishes the amount that the English 16 learner’s district of residence is required to pay to the 17 receiving district. These provisions apply to open enrollment 18 applications, requests, and notifications filed by a parent or 19 guardian on or after the effective date of the bill. 20 The bill makes other nonsubstantive terminology changes 21 to Code section 282.18(7)(b)(1), which describes amounts 22 that districts of residence are required to pay to receiving 23 districts for students who open enroll. 24 -3- LSB 5484YC (1) 91 jda/jh 3/ 3
